title: Read approved preference fields with brokered credentials
description: Validates the contract method/args projection of a Bindle RPC envelope addressed to @preferences. Every resource-field value is a list of uniform references in owner order (integrations §5.1, AMD-C3/C9). Brokered members name the integration endpoint and resource and carry a provider-minted RFC 9068 token of at most 300 seconds; consumers treat tokens as opaque, never persist them past expires_at and refresh by reading again. Served only by providers declaring brokered-resources.v1. Provisional (EXT-X8, 2026-10-21); publish changes under a new URL.

values.description: Approved fields. Non-resource fields keep their v1 value; resource fields are arrays of #/$defs/reference.

requiresConsent.description: Fields with an assigned member this consumer has not approved; that member is omitted, approved members remain.

seq.description: Integration readers only: the connection's configuration seq, comparable with preferences-updated events (§6.2).

id.description: The provider's opaque scoped reference, never the integration's resource string.

label.description: Inert plain text; integration labels are unverified.

methods.description: Brokered members: the exact contract to methods map in the token (bindle.methods).

token.description: Opaque. Issuer-hosted: an attenuated issuer RPC token. Brokered: an RFC 9068 at+jwt for broker.endpoint only.

broker.description: Present only for brokered members. Send the RPC envelope to endpoint with resource set to broker.resource.

read.permission: Approved fields and live resource assignment for this exact contract/method; brokered tokens only while the grant, assignment, record and connection are live.
